title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 –Urban Co-operative Bank Limited, Dehradun - Extension of Period
description: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to Urban Co-operative Bank Limited, Dehradun vide Directive No. DDN.DOS.QAG.No.S168/03-04-007/2025-2026 dated February 09, 2026, for a period of 06 months from close of business on February 10, 2026 up to close of business on August 10, 2026.
